# 23 October: provenance correction and A4 revision

The [provenance clarification](../../../PROVENANCE-CLARIFICATION.md) records the distinction between human input, automatic context, workflow quarantine, and philosophical rejection. The inspected project instructions contain no identified human philosophical contribution. None of the twelve inspected referee reports rejects an essay because of memory. Historical disclosures remain available, and the official relevant-memory restriction remains in force.

## New substantive work

- [A4 v2 manuscript](A4-v2-external.md), *Causal Refinement and the Existence of a Direct Basis*: 2,938 words under the repository counter, excluding references.
- [Revision and source record](A4-REVISION-NOTES.md).
- [Methodology draft](A4-v2-methodology.md).
- [Independent finite checks](check_a4_revision.py) and [results](A4-checks.json).

The central result is an exact criterion within the specified relay class: the original causal conditions recover the endpoint verdict precisely when there is a finite forward path through globally direct links. The new ordered-sum example shows that having an immediate predecessor at every noninitial stage is still insufficient. The infinite proof is written out; finite checks provide separate validation, not a substitute for that proof.

The revision answers part of report S7 on packet P-3b36. It remains conditional on the causal interpretation, aptness, stability, and completeness of the chosen domain. Broader originality and philosophical significance still need independent assessment. The authors' previously unread sequel was accessed and its relevant argument checked.

This is a new version of the external A4 manuscript, not a new essay track and not a replacement for Claude's A4 normality cards. The inventory remains ten developed manuscript tracks plus eight exploratory drafts, with overlap between some tracks. E2 v5 and O5 v3 are in the [previous revision checkpoint](../revisions-20261023/README.md).

## Validation and status

The standard word-count and manuscript scan pass. The research script passes 1,404 causal-verdict queries, 1,092 conjunction-minimality queries, and eight refinement/restriction checks. No claim of finalist quality follows from those checks. This checkpoint contains editable Markdown, not a new PDF submission packet. No contest submission has been made.
